snippet.title: Monster Care Simulator - Trailer
snippet.description:

Become the manager of a care center for adorable little monsters in Monster Care Simulator. Earn money by meeting their needs, improve your facilities, and customize the environment to provide the best care and see the creatures thrive. Monster Care Simulator is coming soon to PC (Steam).
